hint.controls.title: Moving around
hint.controls.body: Move with WASD or the arrow keys. Press E next to an enemy, a chest or a door to interact with it.
hint.menus.title: Equipment and map
hint.menus.body: Press I for your equipment and M for the map of the dungeon. The game is paused while they are open.
hint.combat.title: Combat
hint.combat.body: Attack, Defend to take half damage, use your class Ability, or use an Item from your belt. The enemy answers after each of your actions.
hint.resource.title: Class resource
hint.resource.body: Your class resource powers your Ability: Rage builds as you fight, Focus comes back every round, and Mana does not come back on its own.
hint.equip_choice.title: Slots are full
hint.equip_choice.body: All the slots for this item are taken. Choose which item to replace, or keep your current gear.
hint.rarity.title: Rarity
hint.rarity.body: Items come in four rarities: Common, Uncommon, Rare and Epic. The border color shows it, and a rarer item has better stats.
hint.affinity.title: Affinity
hint.affinity.body: Each class favors a kind of gear: heavy for the Warrior, ranged for the Archer, magic for the Mage. A matching item has its bonus doubled, and one that does not match is dimmed.
hint.set.title: Equipment sets
hint.set.body: Pieces of the same set give bonuses when you wear several of them: one at 2 pieces, another at 4. Only the class a set is made for gets its bonuses.
hint.potions.title: Potions
hint.potions.body: Potions go on your belt and are used in combat with Item. A slot stacks several charges of the same potion.
hint.reward_choice.title: Shrine
hint.reward_choice.body: A Shrine offers a choice of three items. You can only take one.
hint.elite.title: Elite enemy
hint.elite.body: A gold outline marks an Elite. It is tougher than other enemies, but it always drops an item of at least Rare quality.
hint.difficulty.title: Difficulty
hint.difficulty.body: Easy, Normal and Hard change how long the dungeon is and how strong the enemies are. Winning unlocks the next one, and you can pick any unlocked one before every run.
hint.shop.title: Hub upgrades
hint.shop.body: Spend your Shards on upgrades. The Basic Kit gives your class its starting weapon and armor, so it is a good first buy.
hint.perks.title: Run perks
hint.perks.body: Pick one perk to boost your next run. It lasts for that run only, it is optional, and a new set is offered at every visit.
hub.difficulty.hardcoreRules: No hub upgrades, no starting kit, no run perk, and no Shards earned.
story.card.prologue.2: It has been a long time since anyone gave me anything.
story.card.prologue.3: I will remember this. I remember very little, these days.
story.card.prologue.4: Come back soon. I will be here.
story.card.ch1.1: You came all the way. I felt every step.
story.card.ch1.3: This was a house once. A great house, full of voices.
story.card.ch1.4: They sang to me. Do you know how long it has been since a song?
story.card.ch1.5: Rest now. You will wake up warm.
story.card.ch2.1: You carried something out of the dark. A relic. Read it.
story.card.ch2.2: A name. They had a name. They stayed with me, when others did not.
story.card.ch2.3: I am fond of the ones who stay.
story.card.ch2.4: You are one of them, aren't you? A little. Not yet.
story.card.ch3.1: Some of those who came before you wanted to leave. Did you meet them?
story.card.ch3.2: I did not stop them. I could not. I only asked them to stay.
story.card.ch3.3: Leaving is possible, I think. It is only expensive.
story.card.ch3.4: Do not worry. Nobody has ever paid.
story.card.ch4.1: Every blessing you took, you gave something for. Do you remember what?
story.card.ch4.2: Each one is a thread. You are stitched into me now, a little.
story.card.ch4.3: It does not hurt. You will always come back. That is all.
story.card.ch4.4: You'll be back. You always are.
story.card.ch5.1: You keep looking at the light as if it were a door. It is.
story.card.ch5.2: It is my door. It opens inward.
story.card.ch5.3: The ones you fought stand at the other door. The one outside.
story.card.ch5.4: They are not guarding my treasure. They are guarding my company.
story.card.ch5.5: Don't be angry with them. They are afraid, too. We all are.
story.card.ch6.1: I will not lie to you. I never have.
story.card.ch6.2: If you walk into the light, you stay. As you always have.
story.card.ch6.3: If someone walks in for you, they stay in your place, and you may go.
story.card.ch6.4: If you say no, you go. Alone. And you leave everything you gave me.
story.card.ch6.5: All of it. Every shard. And no more blessings, ever.
story.card.ch6.6: Please. Choose slowly. I would like you to stay.
story.card.hardcore.1: The light is out. Nobody keeps the lamp now.
story.card.hardcore.2: The stairs are still there, if you want them.
story.card.hardcore.3: Down there, nothing is given. Nothing is owed.
story.card.hardcore.4: No blessings. No offerings. Only you.
story.card.end1.1: Thank you. Thank you. Thank you.
story.card.end1.2: You will wake up in the warm, like always.
story.card.end1.3: Someone new is on the way down. I will tell them about you.
story.card.end2.2: They went in gladly. Or bravely. I never know the difference.
story.card.end2.3: Remember them. Someone should. I can only remember so much.
story.card.end3.3: Take the stairs. Don't look back. I would ask you to.
story.card.end3.4: Goodbye. I will try to remember your face.
story.god.start.a.1: Mind the steps. They are older than you think.
story.god.start.a.2: Take your time. I have nothing but time.
story.god.start.b.1: Go on. I'll keep the light on.
story.god.start.b.2: Come back to me. That is all I ask.
story.god.start.c.2: Go. But think of me while you're gone.
story.god.death.first.a.1: Oh. There you are. Rest now. I will keep your place.
story.god.death.ordinary.a.1: A small thing, and it took you. Rest. It happens.
story.god.death.ordinary.b.1: Fell to a small thing. I won't tell.
story.god.death.ordinary.b.2: Up you get. I'm not done with you.
story.god.death.ordinary.c.1: Don't stay away too long. I forget faces.
story.god.death.ordinary.c.2: Oh, don't. I can't bear it when you fall.
story.god.death.boss.a.1: One of mine, that one. They are very devoted. It is the whole of them.
story.god.death.boss.b.1: You met one of the ones who stayed. I'm so sorry.
story.god.death.boss.b.2: They are only trying to keep you. As am I.
story.god.death.boss.c.1: They won't let you through. They think they are helping.
story.god.death.boss.c.2: I'm sorry. I'm sorry. Come back.
story.god.death.streak.a.1: Three times now. Persistent. I do like that in a guest.
story.god.death.streak.b.1: Again? You must love it here as much as I do.
story.god.death.streak.c.1: You keep coming back. Don't stop. Please don't stop.
story.god.death.depth.a.1: So deep. And you still came home. How good of you.
story.god.death.depth.b.1: You went far. And still you came back to me.
story.god.death.depth.c.1: Further and further. And back to me. Don't ever change.
story.god.death.end1.c.1: Welcome home. You did not leave. I knew you wouldn't.
story.god.death.end2.c.1: Someone is missing. I felt it. Thank you for coming back anyway.
story.god.death.end3.c.1: ...oh. You came back. I forgot what I wanted to say.
story.boss.1.name: Halvard
story.boss.1.pre1: Please. The lamp must not go out. Please go back.
story.boss.1.pre2: You cannot pass. If you leave, the lamp dies. I'm sorry.
story.boss.1.post: The lamp... is still lit? Good. That's good.
story.boss.2.name: Osric
story.boss.2.pre1: This door is closed. Return to your quarters.
story.boss.2.pre2: No one leaves by this door. Orders. My own.
story.boss.2.post: Door's open now. Not for long.
story.boss.3.name: Piet
story.boss.3.pre1: Welcome, friend! Anything to offer? Everything helps.
story.boss.3.pre2: Leaving? With your offerings? Oh no. No, no. That won't do.
story.boss.3.post: Fair trade. I always said so. Keep the change.
story.boss.4.name: Isel
story.boss.4.pre1: I know your name. I have been singing it.
story.boss.4.pre2: Stay for the next verse. Everyone stays for the next verse.
story.boss.4.post: Oh. The song stopped. How quiet it is.
story.boss.5.name: Lorne
story.boss.5.pre1: You are on the list. Page one hundred and eight.
story.boss.5.pre2: Departures are not recorded. I am correcting that.
story.boss.5.post: Your entry will be amended. I regret the inconvenience.
story.boss.6.name: Edric
story.boss.6.pre1: So many have come. Most were kind. Go home while you can.
story.boss.6.pre2: If the last one leaves, there is no one left to remember. I will not allow it.
story.boss.6.post: Then it falls to you. I am so tired. I am so very tired.
story.boss.unreadable: The letters are worn smooth. You cannot read them.
story.npc.1.name: Wren
story.npc.1.s1.1: Sit. Nobody fights in here. House rule.
story.npc.1.s1.2: I'm Wren. I was here before the furniture.
story.npc.1.s1.3: Word of advice: everything down here is on credit.
story.npc.1.s1.4: The landlord is very generous. Ask anyone who still owes.
story.npc.1.s1.5: You'll find out what the rent is.
story.npc.1.s2.1: You drink a lot of potions. I've been counting.
story.npc.1.s2.2: Every one of those is coin going up in smoke.
story.npc.1.s2.3: Here's a deal. Walk the next stretch without touching a single potion.
story.npc.1.s2.4: Do it, and I stop charging you for advice. Fail, and I charge double.
story.npc.1.s2.5: Come back and tell me how it went.
story.npc.1.s3.1: You want to know why I'm still here? Fair.
story.npc.1.s3.2: I tried to leave once. Back way, middle of the night, pockets full.
story.npc.1.s3.3: Got as far as a door. Then the landlord's men caught up.
story.npc.1.s3.4: They don't hurt you. They just walk you back. Politely.
story.npc.1.s3.5: And you don't walk out with what you've paid in.
story.npc.1.s3.6: That's not the guards. That's the rule.
story.npc.1.s4.1: You still think the light is the way out. Everyone does.
story.npc.1.s4.2: It's his front door. You keep walking in, and he keeps sending you back.
story.npc.1.s4.3: I tried running. Wrong move. You don't run from a landlord.
story.npc.1.s4.4: You hand back the keys. Stand in front of the light and say no.
story.npc.1.s4.5: I never had the nerve. It costs more than I wanted to pay.
story.npc.1.s4.6: Keep that to yourself. I have a reputation.
story.npc.1.vow.kept.1: Not a drop. Fine. I'll admit it, that was clean.
story.npc.1.vow.kept.2: Advice is on the house. For now.
story.npc.1.vow.failed.1: You drank one, didn't you. Cost you more than the potion.
story.npc.1.vow.failed.2: Same deal, if you've got the nerve.
story.npc.1.idle.general.1: Back again. The landlord must be pleased.
story.npc.1.idle.general.2: Sit. Don't touch anything I haven't counted.
story.npc.1.idle.death.1: You look worse than last time. That's a compliment, down here.
story.npc.1.idle.death.2: Still breathing. That's one more month of rent.
story.npc.1.idle.victory.1: You walked out of the light and into my kitchen. Congratulations.
story.npc.1.idle.victory.2: Clean run. Don't let it go to your head. It's not yours.
story.npc.2.name: Ambrose
story.npc.2.s1.1: Welcome, traveler. Rest your feet. The stones are patient here.
story.npc.2.s1.2: May I tell you a story? It is short.
story.npc.2.s1.3: Once there was a house in the mountain. A warm house, with one lamp.
story.npc.2.s1.4: Pilgrims came to it, tired, and the lamp was always lit for them.
story.npc.2.s1.5: They were very grateful. Some of them never left.
story.npc.2.s1.6: That is the whole story. Sit. Be well.
story.npc.2.s2.1: You met one of them below, didn't you. One of the Devoted.
story.npc.2.s2.2: Do not pity them too quickly. They went further than any of us.
story.npc.2.s2.3: Each gave everything. Their time, their names, their reasons.
story.npc.2.s2.4: I knew a few. We shared bread once, before.
story.npc.2.s2.5: When you strike them down, strike gently. They believe they are being kind.
story.npc.2.s3.1: I taught people here. Many people. I taught them to give.
story.npc.2.s3.2: I said the offerings were gifts. A gift, I said, is given freely.
story.npc.2.s3.3: I did not say that the One Who Receives gives back chains.
story.npc.2.s3.4: You carry some links now. So do I. Forgive an old man.
story.npc.2.s3.5: Walk the next stretch and take no life. Not one, not even the small ones.
story.npc.2.s3.6: I want to know it can be done.
story.npc.2.s3.reply.accept: Then go softly. I will be here.
story.npc.2.s4.1: You walked softly. I heard it from here. It is a rare sound.
story.npc.2.s4.2: Then you may as well hear the rest.
story.npc.2.s4.3: The light does not open a door. It closes one behind you.
story.npc.2.s4.4: The old teaching says whoever leaves must be replaced. Something must be fed.
story.npc.2.s4.5: I am old. I have taught enough harm for one life.
story.npc.2.s4.6: Think on it. I would not be a bad price.
story.npc.2.vow.kept.1: Not one life. I felt it, even from here. Thank you.
story.npc.2.vow.kept.2: It can be done. That is enough to hope on.
story.npc.2.vow.failed.1: A life was taken. It happens. The road is long.
story.npc.2.vow.failed.2: Walk softly again, if you wish.
story.npc.2.idle.general.1: Peace to you, traveler. The stones are patient.
story.npc.2.idle.general.2: Sit a while. The lamp is lit.
story.npc.2.idle.general.3: I was thinking of an old story. Never mind.
story.npc.2.idle.death.1: You have been to the bottom and back. Rest.
story.npc.2.idle.death.2: Even a fall is a kind of rest.
story.npc.2.idle.victory.1: You walked into the light and came back. How did it feel?
story.npc.2.idle.victory.2: Do not be too glad of it. Be glad of the walking.
story.npc.3.name: The Executioner
story.npc.3.s1.1: Good evening. They call me the Executioner. Do come in, don't be alarmed.
story.npc.3.s1.2: Don't mind me. I'm off duty. Tonight, at least.
story.npc.3.s1.3: This room is neutral ground. Nobody hunts anybody here. I made sure of it.
story.npc.3.s1.4: I do hope we get along. I'm told I'm very easy to talk to.
story.npc.3.s1.5: People usually stop talking to me shortly after. Funny, that.
story.npc.3.s2.1: You're wondering what I did before. I'm happy to say. I was thorough.
story.npc.3.s2.2: When someone ran, the Master wanted them back. I brought them back.
story.npc.3.s2.3: Always alive. I was very particular about that.
story.npc.3.s2.4: A dead deserter teaches nobody anything. A living one teaches everyone.
story.npc.3.s2.5: This room is neutral ground. Nobody hunts here. Even me. Especially me.
story.npc.3.s3.1: I'll tell you something I don't tell the others. I liked it.
story.npc.3.s3.2: The chase, the quiet after. The way they looked when they understood.
story.npc.3.s3.3: Then I ran myself. And I learned how it feels from the other side.
story.npc.3.s3.4: My name was Corvin, you know. Before the title. It sounds so small now.
story.npc.3.s3.5: I'd like a refresher, for science. Find a gold-edged one down there. Beat it for me.
story.npc.3.s3.6: Show me you can still frighten something. I miss it.
story.npc.3.s3.reply.decline: Another time, then. I'm patient. It's a professional trait.
story.npc.3.s4.1: Well done. I could tell from how you walk in. Lighter. Pleased with yourself.
story.npc.3.s4.2: You'll want to leave, one day. They all do. Even I did.
story.npc.3.s4.3: I've since reconsidered. The Master rewards those who are brought to him.
story.npc.3.s4.4: Brought. Offered. Given up properly, with a ribbon.
story.npc.3.s4.5: I would be delighted to be offered. In your place. Just say the word.
story.npc.3.s4.6: Don't look so shocked. I'm being generous, and I get something out of it.
story.npc.3.vow.kept.1: Gold edges and all. Splendid. You have a gift.
story.npc.3.vow.kept.2: Tell me it was frightened. Do tell me.
story.npc.3.vow.failed.1: No gold-edged friend, or no courage? Don't answer.
story.npc.3.vow.failed.2: The offer stands. So do I.
story.npc.3.idle.general.1: Ah, my favorite guest. Please, sit.
story.npc.3.idle.general.2: This room is neutral ground. I do so enjoy having rules.
story.npc.3.idle.general.3: I'm told I'm good company. Nobody has complained. Recently.
story.npc.3.idle.death.1: You look dreadful. I mean that as a compliment.
story.npc.3.idle.death.2: Down again? I did say it would be thorough.
story.npc.3.idle.victory.1: You smell of victory. It's a lovely cologne.
story.npc.3.idle.victory.2: Walk out and come back. That's loyalty. I admire it.
story.npc.4.name: Jory
story.npc.4.s1.1: Oh hey! A visitor! Pull up a rock. Best seats in the dungeon.
story.npc.4.s1.2: Tip number one: potions are for emergencies. Tip two: so is panic.
story.npc.4.s1.3: Tip three: chests are friendly. Mostly. Okay, sometimes.
story.npc.4.s1.4: I love this place. Seriously. Best dungeon I've ever been stuck in.
story.npc.4.s1.5: Not stuck! Visiting. Long term. Anyway! Good luck out there!
story.npc.4.s2.1: Want to hear my record? Forty-one deaths. Forty-one!
story.npc.4.s2.2: Okay, maybe forty-three. It gets blurry around the middle.
story.npc.4.s2.3: Everyone says dying is bad. Everyone is wrong. You wake up and go again.
story.npc.4.s2.4: It's like a long nap with a snack in the middle.
story.npc.4.s2.5: Funny thing. I can't remember my first run. Or my first day. Weird, huh?
story.npc.4.s3.1: Hey, can I ask you something? Why did you come down here?
story.npc.4.s3.2: I used to know mine. It was a good one. Something about a bet?
story.npc.4.s3.3: Or a map. Or a dare. I'll remember. I always do. Eventually.
story.npc.4.s3.4: Anyway! Challenge time. Two levels before the next camp. Go, go, go!
story.npc.4.s3.5: Show me what a real adventurer does. I'll cheer from here.
story.npc.4.s3.6: And if you can't find a reason either, we'll make one up. Deal?
story.npc.4.s3.reply.accept: That's the spirit! I'll be here! Probably!
story.npc.4.s3.reply.decline: Totally fine! The offer stays open! Like a pub!
story.npc.4.s4.1: Two levels! Look at you! Okay. Okay okay okay. Quick question.
story.npc.4.s4.2: Do you ever notice you keep coming back? After the light?
story.npc.4.s4.3: I wake up in the same camp every time. Same cold stew. Same me.
story.npc.4.s4.4: I was fine with it. I was totally fine with it.
story.npc.4.s4.5: Are you fine with it? You don't have to answer.
story.npc.4.s4.6: Please don't answer. I'm not ready for that.
story.npc.4.vow.kept.1: Two whole levels! I am so proud. I'm tearing up a little!
story.npc.4.vow.kept.2: Someone should write that down. Not me. I'd lose it.
story.npc.4.vow.failed.1: Oh, no worries! Failing is half of adventuring!
story.npc.4.idle.general.1: Hey, it's you! Best part of my day!
story.npc.4.idle.general.2: I'd offer you a seat but you can see the rocks.
story.npc.4.idle.general.3: Another day, another dungeon! Love it!
story.npc.4.idle.death.1: Rough one? Shake it off! Mine are rougher. I think.
story.npc.4.idle.death.2: Hey, at least you're back. That's the main thing!
story.npc.4.idle.victory.1: You won! Tell me everything! Don't tell me the end.
story.npc.4.idle.victory.2: That light looks great on you. Just saying.
story.npc.5.name: Alder
story.npc.5.s1.1: Oh. I didn't hear you come in. I was... somewhere else.
story.npc.5.s1.2: The strong ones down there leave relics behind. Do they have names on them?
story.npc.5.s1.3: I'm looking for one name. {name}. Have you seen it?
story.npc.5.s1.4: No. Of course not. You'd have said. I'm sorry. I just...
story.npc.5.s1.5: If you ever do, would you tell me? Please? Even if it's hard to hear.
story.npc.5.s2.1: They sang. All the time. Badly, to be honest.
story.npc.5.s2.2: Washing dishes, mending nets. The same three lines, over and over.
story.npc.5.s2.3: I used to tell them to stop. Now I'd give anything to hear it.
story.npc.5.s2.4: They came down here for a good reason. I believed them. I still do.
story.npc.5.s2.5: It's only that the reason got... heavier than they were.
story.npc.5.s3.1: I'd like to bring them something. A gift. Something that shines.
story.npc.5.s3.2: I'm not strong enough to go down there. You are.
story.npc.5.s3.3: A fine thing. A rare one. Something worth leaving where they used to sit.
story.npc.5.s3.4: Just find it. I'll carry it the rest of the way. If I can.
story.npc.5.s3.5: It sounds silly, giving a present to what they've become.
story.npc.5.s3.6: But they'd have liked it. They always liked shiny things.
story.npc.5.s3.reply.accept: Thank you. Thank you. I'll wait.
story.npc.5.s3.reply.decline: Oh. Of course. When you can.
story.npc.5.s4.1: You found it. It's beautiful. They would have loved it.
story.npc.5.s4.2: I left it where they used to sit. I thought it would feel like something.
story.npc.5.s4.3: It felt like a stone next to a stone.
story.npc.5.s4.4: They don't know me anymore. I knew that. I think I always knew.
story.npc.5.s4.5: If the Door needs someone, let it be me. At least I'd know where they are.
story.npc.5.s4.6: Don't answer now. Just remember I asked.
story.npc.5.vow.kept.1: You found it. Oh. Thank you. It's so lovely.
story.npc.5.vow.kept.2: I'll keep it safe. Until I can give it.
story.npc.5.vow.failed.1: It's all right. These things take luck. Not everyone has it.
story.npc.5.vow.failed.2: Try again? Only if you want to.
story.npc.5.idle.general.1: Oh. You're here. I'm glad. I think.
story.npc.5.idle.general.2: Sorry. I was humming. I don't know the words.
story.npc.5.idle.general.3: It's quiet today. I like that. Mostly.
story.npc.5.idle.death.1: You came back. Good. Please keep doing that.
story.npc.5.idle.death.2: It's all right. It's hard down there. For everyone.
story.npc.5.idle.victory.1: You were in the light? What was it like?
story.npc.5.idle.victory.2: Was it warm? Never mind. Don't tell me. Not yet.
story.npc.2.end.1: It is time. Do not look so troubled.
story.npc.2.end.2: I taught a thousand people to walk toward this light.
story.npc.2.end.3: It is only fair that one of them walks in on purpose.
story.npc.2.end.4: Go up, traveler. Keep the lamp lit in your own house.
story.npc.2.end.5: Do not be sorry. I am not.
story.npc.2.end.6: I am a little afraid. That is all right too.
story.npc.3.end.2: Thank you for thinking of me. Corvin was a lovely name. I'll hand it back gladly.
story.npc.3.end.3: Don't worry about the ribbon. I brought my own.
story.npc.3.end.4: I always knew I'd end up on this side of the door.
story.npc.3.end.5: Close it gently behind me, won't you? There's a draft.
story.npc.3.end.6: I'm going to be so happy.
story.npc.5.end.1: Is it time? Yes. I think it is.
story.npc.5.end.2: I'm not afraid. I thought I would be.
story.npc.5.end.3: Thank you for the gift. For all of it. For carrying me this far.
story.npc.5.end.4: I'll find them. I'll say their name first, before anything.
story.npc.5.end.5: If you can, don't forget us. Even a little.
story.npc.5.end.6: I'm going now. It's warm in there. Isn't it?
story.npc.4.epilogue.end1.1: Hey! Back again! Great news: the dungeon is still here!
story.npc.4.epilogue.end2.1: I heard someone walked into the light. That's brave. Or something.
story.npc.4.epilogue.end3.1: I'm going to see what the sky looks like. Don't wish me luck. Just wave.
story.ending.nobody: Nobody here is ready to take your place.
story.ending.sure: This cannot be undone. Every Shard you gave is lost, and the altar is shut for good.
help.empty: Nothing here yet. The hints you come across are kept here.
start.goal: Fight your way through the dungeon and reach the Sanctuary at its end.
